from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Party(BaseModel):
    """A person or entity named in the legal document with their role."""
    name: str | None = Field(description="The full name of the party as written")
    role: str | None = Field(description="Their procedural role (e.g., Appellant, Plaintiff, Defendant)")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt identifying the party and role")

class Fee(BaseModel):
    """A specific court fee or cost mentioned in the judgment."""
    amount: str | None = Field(description="The fee amount (e.g., 100, 5717.50)")
    payer: str | None = Field(description="Who is responsible for the fee")
    stage: str | None = Field(description="Litigation stage (e.g., First Instance, Second Instance, Retrial)")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt containing the fee details")

class Decision(BaseModel):
    """The court's ruling or decision made in the case."""
    outcome: str | None = Field(description="The core ruling (e.g., Dismiss Appeal, Maintain Original Verdict)")
    details: str | None = Field(description="Specific orders or modifications (e.g., payment terms, property division)")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt of the court's decision paragraph")

class CaseInfo(BaseModel):
    """High-level classification of the case and document."""
    cause: str | None = Field(description="The nature of the dispute (e.g., Inheritance, Copyright, Execution Objection)")
    level: str | None = Field(description="Procedural level (e.g., Second Instance, First Instance)")
    doc_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of document (e.g., Civil Judgment, Civil Ruling)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    parties: list[Party]
    fees: list[Fee]
    decisions: list[Decision]
    case_info: list[CaseInfo]
